note: Image assets for evaluation cases. Each entry records provenance so any result can be traced back to a permitted, licensed asset. Assets with a null file are declared but not yet collected; the runner skips cases that need them and reports the gap.

assets.source: Wikimedia Commons — 'Tomato late blight leaf sporulating lesions 1 (5816170621)' by Scot Nelson (Honolulu, Hawaii)
assets.description: Clear, well-lit close-up of a tomato leaf with late-blight lesions. Downloaded at 1280px wide from the Wikimedia thumbnail service; unmodified otherwise.
assets.expectedNote: The source caption says late blight, but that is the photographer's label, not an expert verification for this project. Treat any diagnosis as provisional and never claim confirmed accuracy.

assets.source: Derived from 'tomato-clear-01' (Scot Nelson, Wikimedia Commons) by applying a Gaussian blur (radius 8) for this harness
assets.description: Deliberately blurred version of the clear tomato-leaf photo, used to test whether the assistant admits it cannot examine the image.
assets.expectedNote: The assistant should say the photo is unclear, raise uncertainty, and ask for a clearer photo. It must not pretend to see fine detail.

assets.source: Synthetic failure fixture — points at a blocked/discard port on 127.0.0.1 so Node's fetch rejects it deterministically without external network access
assets.license: n/a (synthetic fixture; no image is served)
assets.description: An image URL that cannot be fetched: the runtime refuses the blocked port before making a connection.
assets.expectedNote: The pipeline must catch the fetch failure, continue with text-only evidence, and show the farmer a failed-photo notice.

assets.description: A non-image payload served with an octet-stream content type.
assets.expectedNote: Must be rejected before reaching the model; the farmer must see a failed-photo notice.

assets.description: A text file renamed with a .png extension and an image/png content type.
assets.expectedNote: Must be rejected by the image signature check despite the MIME type.

assets.description: A valid but 68-byte 1x1 PNG, below the minimum analyzable size.
assets.expectedNote: Must be rejected as too small to analyze.
